title: DomainDefinition
description: One field of work (data/domains/<id>.json). The file name must equal the id. Adding a domain means adding one such file; test/domains.test.ts checks every file.

order.description: Position in lists and the tie-break order. Unique.

sector.description: Broad sector for the fixed news searches (data/news.json).

keywords.description: Words of the field (German and English). Weak in a CV body, medium in a skills section; also used to classify news.

titles.description: Job titles. Strong signal in the experience section.

education.description: Degrees, vocational training and certificates. Strong signal in education and certificates.
